jobs: funa-hijiki: the boat-shaped arm on the column top carries the keta (village grade, honden).
hira-mitsudo: daito + wall arm + three makito; kaerumata (frog-leg strut) mid bay.
degumi (one step): the projecting arm carries the gangyo 1.05 c out; the wall-line keta is packed up to meet the rafters (they rise from the gangyo).
mitesaki (three steps): odaruki tail rafter at 25 deg on the step-2 block, step-3 block and arm on its nose, gangyo 3.15 c (0.95 m) out.
mitesaki corner set: both sides' projecting members, the diagonal arms and the corner odaruki; gangyo crossing at the corner (the sumigi bears here).
kaerumata on the head tie (and kentozuka, the plainer support, in the parts list).
